title: Gemma 4 (family)
excerpt: Public bundled note: Gemma-family local routes are useful for low-latency, privacy-sensitive, and cost-sensitive workloads when the task fits the local context and quality envelope. Treat any local-model recommendation as workload-specific and validate against the user's own task traces before routing production traffic.

title: GLM 5.2
excerpt: Public bundled note: GLM 5.2 is represented here as a cloud route candidate for interactive agent workflows. Keep it behind measured routing gates: compare task success, latency, and cost against local and frontier alternatives before making it a default for a workload.

title: Gemma 4 Understudy snapshots
excerpt: Public bundled note: Understudy snapshots are serving artifacts derived from upstream model families. Treat MLX, QAT, OptiQ, and BF16 as variant details on the Google Gemma family, not as a standalone model-provider taxonomy. Profile the user's machine, warm only selected routes, and keep a cloud fallback when local quality or latency misses the workload target.
